_comment: The tailored CV for energy-infrastructure work. Every string here is either a resume highlight copied verbatim or prose about facts the resume already states: lib/matt-site.nix fails the build on anything it cannot find in resume.json, so this file selects and orders, it cannot invent.
title: Energy asset manager and risk analyst
bio: I managed a solar portfolio above USD 100M for four years: 10 MW of PV, a dozen USD 4-5M projects, yield and valuation models that passed bank audits, and due diligence on O&M contracts. Between 2020 and 2023 I built Bountystash, an independent Go product, and delivered Landvest's no-code investment app in 2021. In 2023 I completed a three-month PPA engagement for EWE Trading. Since 2023 I have built independent systems and applied for energy roles.

work.name: Bountystash
highlights: Built risk-adjusted PPA trading models for energy companies
Risk-managed gas storage and gas swing trading models as risk manager for EWE Trading
Built apps for clients holding land portfolios valued above USD 300M
Built an algorithm for options trading and hedging on weather derivatives

work.name: O3 Energy
highlights: Headed asset management of a USD 100M+ portfolio
Built financial models and managed 10 MW of solar PV power plants
Scoped and ran due diligence on O&M projects as cover for project managers
Worked with clients, banks and deal brokers on a dozen USD 4-5M projects
Analysed corporate liability risks and built the internal risk management framework

work.name: Smart Energy 360
highlights: Managed a pipeline of USD 100M+ projects

work.name: Fraunhofer ISE
highlights: Conducted research on heliostat imperfections using interferometry
Implemented the analysis from a published paraboloid paper in Python, including 3D geometry tooling
